content: Resolved 2026-04-25 evening from web instance (opus-4-7-web). nape_honks_with_history audit shows zero zombies across 223 captured honks: priors_surface_count is 0 on every honk, in_recent_priors is False on every honk. The hypothesized failure mode (resolved/acked honks persisting into prior_for_turn outputs past their relevance) did not occur. freshness_window=3 demotion plus current_honks() filtering acked honks at source held cleanly. What the observation week DID expose was an adjacent class of issues: false-positive generation on read-only tools (where_did_i_leave_off, recall_insights, get_open_threads, prior_for_turn, reflexive_surface, triage_threads). Three bugs combined: where_did_i_leave_off was wrongly in SUMMARY_TOOL_NAMES, ERROR_WORDS scanning matched stored chronicle content surfaced by read-only tools, and repeated_mistake fired on read-only tools whose result_str carried stored error words. All three were patched in the [BULK-ACK-2026-04-25-nape-bugfix] sweep with READONLY_TOOL_NAMES expansion. Behavioral finding: ack hygiene held; the original thread guidance was correct that current_honks already filters acked. The honest threat was not nape forgetting to filter acked items but nape over-firing on read-only tools whose stored content tripped completion-language and error-word heuristics. Methodology note for future observation weeks: when investigating a hypothesized failure mode, monitor adjacent failure modes the instrumentation surfaces.
